counter.label: {count, plural, =0 {No voices yet} one {# voice for peace} other {# voices for peace}}
counter.countries: {count, plural, =0 {from nowhere yet} one {from # country} other {from # countries}}
counter.note: One number, for everyone. We do not count by nation, faith or side.

hero.title: Choose peace, and be counted.
hero.body: Anyone may add their voice — from any country, any faith, any side of any conflict. No account is needed, and it takes less than a minute.

wall.title: The Wall of Voices
wall.subtitle: Shown in a different order for every reader, so that no voice is placed above another.
wall.empty: No voices have been published yet. Yours can be the first.

form.title: Add your voice
form.intro: You are saying one thing: that you choose peace and peaceful coexistence.
form.name: What shall we call you?
form.nameHelp: A first name, or any name you choose. It does not have to be your legal name.
form.countryHelp: Country only. We never ask for a city or an address, and we never record one.
form.messageHelp: Optional, up to {max} characters, in any language.
form.emailHelp: Only used to send you a link that removes your voice later, in one click. It is never shown and never shared.
form.success: Your voice has been added. Thank you.
form.successWithEmail: Your voice has been added. We have sent you a link that removes it at any time, in one click.
form.offline: You are offline. Your voice is saved on this device and will be sent as soon as you are connected.
form.privacyNote: We do not store your location, and we keep no record that can tie this to you unless you ask us to.

withdraw.title: Withdraw your voice
withdraw.body: This removes your voice from the wall and from the count. It cannot be undone, and no reason is required.
withdraw.invalid: This link is no longer valid. It may already have been used.

share.title: Share your voice
share.note: The card carries no location and no full name unless you chose to show them.
